name: nexus-core
description: Software factory para ERPs e sistemas desktop reutilizaveis.

scripts.desktop:start: npm run build:meu-engenheiro && npm run start --workspace @nexus-core/nexus-desktop
scripts.desktop:start:pdv: npm run build:pdv-demo && npm run start:pdv --workspace @nexus-core/nexus-desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build:meu-engenheiro && npm run build:pdv-demo && npm run pack --workspace @nexus-core/nexus-desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:meu-engenheiro: npm run build:meu-engenheiro && npm run dist:meu-engenheiro --workspace @nexus-core/nexus-desktop
scripts.desktop:dist:pdv: npm run build:pdv-demo && npm run dist:pdv --workspace @nexus-core/pdv-rebuild-desktop
